issues: 三张页卡内容全是灰色骨架条，只有一个标题字，放大到 1.7 倍后像空壳
卡片靠 transform scale(1.6–1.74) 放大 560 宽的位图，文字与细线发软（Q2）
三卡叠成阶梯但前后亮度一样，读不出纵深层次
STRONGER 巨字只有一层 4.5px 渐变描边 + 整体 drop-shadow，不像霓虹管；0.6→1 的放大偏猛
没有导出时长常量，工作台按默认 150f 渲染，与 md 的 4.5s 不符；暗场是平涂近黑，没有暗角/颗粒
changes: UiCard 重做为出版级 ClickUp 风页面：带工作区标识与当前页高亮的侧栏导航、头像组 + New 按钮，三页分别是收件箱消息 / 带状态 chip 的任务表 / 首页指标与速度柱图
卡片按 CARD_ZOOM=1.75 用 CSS zoom 布局级放大、外层 scale(s/1.75) 缩回，按目标尺寸栅格化，文字全程锐利；判例要求的全程零模糊、样条、慢转、10f 收束全部不动
后两张卡叠 0.16 / 0.08 的深紫压暗层，阶梯有前后景；卡片补 1px 冷紫发丝外框 + 顶部内高光
巨字改三层霓虹管（SVG 高斯柔辉 + 渐变管身 + 1.4px 白热芯），放大改 0.72→1 的 snappy 曲线，到位后继续极缓长大避免死帧；单环烟雾环原样保留
补 CARD_FLOCK_TUMBLE_DURATION = 135（md 全段 4.5s），加带紫调暗角 + soft-light 颗粒
issuesEn: All three page cards were grey skeleton bars with a single title, reading as empty shells once scaled to 1.7×
Cards were enlarged with transform scale(1.6–1.74) on a 560px-wide bitmap, so text and hairlines went soft (Q2)
The staircase stack had identical brightness front to back, so no depth read
The STRONGER title was a single 4.5px gradient stroke plus a blanket drop-shadow — not a neon tube — and its 0.6→1 scale-up was heavy
No exported duration, so the workbench used the 150f default instead of the md's 4.5s; the dark field was flat near-black with no vignette or grain
changesEn: Rebuilt UiCard as publication-grade ClickUp-style pages: sidebar nav with workspace mark and active-page highlight, avatar stack and New button; the three pages are an inbox, a task table with status chips, and a home view with a metric tile and velocity bars

Cards are laid out at CARD_ZOOM=1.75 via CSS zoom and scaled back with scale(s/1.75), so they rasterise at target size and text stays sharp; the mandated zero-blur, spline flight, slow idle spin and 10f collapse are untouched
The two rear cards get 0.16 / 0.08 deep-violet dimming so the staircase has depth; cards gain a 1px cool-violet hairline and a top inner highlight

Title became a three-layer neon tube (SVG Gaussian bloom, gradient tube, 1.4px white-hot core); scale-in is now 0.72→1 on a snappy curve and keeps growing very slowly after landing to avoid a dead hold; the single smoke ring is kept as-is
Added CARD_FLOCK_TUMBLE_DURATION = 135 (md: 4.5s total) plus a violet-tinted vignette and soft-light grain
